description: computeAgreement keys on non-null file+line, so plan findings (which have neither) all route keyless → divergent: plan deliberation is structurally incapable of agreement (live probe: 0 agreed / 11 divergent with three concerns flagged by both providers in near-identical words). Follow the T-029 method: (1) run 3+ live deliberate plan reviews on real plans, save both providers' raw findings, and characterize how same-concern findings differ (category vocab, wording, ordering); (2) design a plan-specific match key from that data — candidates: normalized category + text similarity, or provider-emitted topic tags in the plan response schema (schema change must keep every property required per L-014); (3) implement in computeAgreement with a plan-findings path + tests; (4) live-verify agreed[] is non-empty on a plan both providers genuinely agree about. Resolves ISS-024.
title: Plan-finding agreement matching: gather live two-provider plan data, then a plan-specific match key (ISS-024)
